title: Gemini voice page is its own page and says it is experimental (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Gemini voice (experimental) is a page of its own in Settings and says it is experimental.

steps.do: Open Settings and find Gemini voice (experimental).
steps.expect: It opens as its own page, and the page says EXPERIMENTAL.

clauses.text: The page draws at every window size and text scale, with every row and button inside the window and clicks working.

steps.do: Make the window small and then large, and raise the text size if the system offers it. Click a row and a button.
steps.expect: Every row and button stays inside the window, and each click does what its label says.
